title: Sum an array
description:
Add up an array of `dq` values with indexed addressing.

```
count 6, sum 108, largest 42
```

starter.main.asm:
global  _start

        section .data
array:  dq      4, 8, 15, 16, 23, 42
count   equ     ($ - array) / 8

        section .text
_start:
        lea     rbx, [rel array]
        xor     ecx, ecx
        xor     r12d, r12d
        ; TODO

        mov     eax, 60
        xor     edi, edi
        syscall

hints: `rcx` is changed by the routines, so finish the loop before printing.
requirements: `[base + rcx*8]` addressing to step through the array.
stretch: Reverse the array in place with two indexes moving towards each other.
